instruction: Start only after task 0001 reports PRACTICE OS PRODUCTION RELEASE VERIFIED. Research current public product information for TaxDome, Canopy, Karbon, Financial Cents, TaxCaddy, SmartVault, Drake, Intuit ProConnect and Lacerte, CCH Axcess, and UltraTax. Use official pages, help docs, release notes, public demos, pricing, integrations, and recent practitioner reviews. Inspect Folio and create docs/product/PREMIUM_TAX_PRODUCT_BLUEPRINT.md containing a feature matrix, user pain points, product gaps, build-vs-integrate decisions, metric definitions, information architecture, visual design principles, implementation milestones, and acceptance criteria. Folio must exceed the baseline for client portal, document collection, organizers, e-signatures, billing, CRM, communications, workflow automation, reporting, capacity, deadlines, extensions, e-file status visibility, IRS transcript workflows, QuickBooks integrations, tax-software interoperability, security, and onboarding. Optimize for fewer manual steps, fewer context switches, exception-driven work, clear client actions, tax-season readiness, and meaningful visual metrics. Define a premium visual bar with purposeful color, calm high-density dashboards, excellent hierarchy, useful motion, polished empty/loading/error states, accessibility, responsive layouts, and white-label client experience. Use established tax-preparation and e-file systems through integrations rather than creating an unvalidated tax calculation engine. Commit and push the blueprint. Do not deploy production.
